ashok: Heads-up: sketching a new approach for spot-heavy fleets. goal: keep 90th/p99 SLO while capturing >40% spot savings. TL;DR: mixed pools + interruption buffer + chargeback.

maria: Can you share current numbers? what's our interruption rate baseline?

ashok: US-west1 g5/rtx6000: avg spot discount ~48% vs on-demand, interruption rate 6.8% last 30d. effective realized savings after restart overhead ~39%.

lucas: How are you modeling restart overhead? we saw some long tail in preemptions.

ashok: Simple model: per-interruption cost = wasted GPU-minutes + requeue latency * per-minute cpu/gpu cost. Example:

```
savings_per_unit = on_demand_cost - spot_cost
interruption_tax = interruption_rate * (wasted_minutes * cost_per_min + recovery_minutes * cost_per_min)
realized_savings = savings_per_unit - interruption_tax
```

maria: Ok. What about allocation/chargeback? FinOps needs a deterministic rule.

ashok: Proposal: Mixed pool target = 70% spot / 30% reserved for high-latency work. Chargeback: teams pay on-demand baseline for reservation; spot savings credited monthly. Interruption reserve = 25% of spot-savings put into an infra pool to cover rescue capacity and cross-team compensation.

sarah: 25% seems high. can we simulate runway for worst-case 15-day spot outage? :thinking_face:

ashok: Ran a sim: with 25% reserve and current usage, we handle up to a 12-day 80% spot capacity loss before we hit soft limit. With 15-day outage we'd need to ramp reserved by 10% temporarily or draw from emergency credits.

maria: If we lower reserve to 15% realized savings bump from 39% -> 42% but risk window shrinks to 8 days. tradeoffs noted.

lucas: Operationally, need autoscale policies: fast fallback to on-demand when queue depth exceeds x or p99 request latency > 200ms. Also prefer per-region weighting.

ashok: @maria can you post a sample chargeback line item for a team using 100k GPU-min/month?

maria: Sure.

```
on_demand_rate = $0.60 per GPU-min
spot_rate = $0.31 per GPU-min
baseline_cost = 100k * on_demand_rate = $60,000
raw_spot_savings = (on_demand_rate - spot_rate) * 100k = $29,000
reserve_cut = 25% -> $7,250 infra reserve
team_credit = raw_spot_savings - reserve_cut = $21,750
net_charge = baseline_cost - team_credit = $38,250 billed
```

sarah: :eyes: can we automate this in billing? maybe add 'interruption line item' to monthly invoice.

maria: We can. I'll add a flag in chargeback exports. also we need to annotate by region.

ashok: Next steps: 1) run 90-day sim with varying interruption shocks (maria/lucas) 2) implement autoscale thresholds (lucas) 3) mock invoice generator (maria) 4) present to finance next Tue. link: <https://redwood.internal/eng-infra/spot-chargeback-proposal>

finops-bot: Reminder: finance review requested by 2026-04-07

lucas: +1. I'll start with config PR for autoscaler.

maria: I'll produce sample invoices and a short slide with sensitivity table.

ashok: Thanks all :heart:
